title: Second Largest
prompt: nums is given. Print the second largest value. Do not sort the list itself in place — use sorted() or a smart max.

tests.name: prints 7
tests.code:
assert printed == ["7"], f"got {printed}"
assert "nums.sort()" not in code, "do not sort in place — the original order matters"
tests.hint: sorted(nums)[-2] — the second item from the top.
